user.title: Connect to RemotePower
user.description: Use a dedicated API key. Disabling certificate verification accepts self-signed certificates, but also untrusted servers. Only do this on a trusted network.

reconfigure.title: Change RemotePower connection
reconfigure.description: Leave API key empty to keep the existing key. No scans or commands are executed. Use this for the same server after an address or credential change.

reauth_confirm.title: Renew RemotePower credentials
reauth_confirm.description: Enter a valid API key. Existing host devices are retained.

error.invalid_url: Enter an HTTPS URL without credentials, query or path.
error.invalid_auth: Invalid API key or insufficient permissions.
error.cannot_connect: Connection failed. Check URL and TLS certificate verification.
error.invalid_response: The server did not return a valid RemotePower report.

init.title: RemotePower options
init.description: APT refresh runs a fixed apt-get update command without installing packages. Control actions allow package upgrades (including RemotePower's cleanup), power operations and upgrade-mode changes. Both options are OFF by default. Existing RemotePower approvals still apply.

data.enable_control: Allow upgrades, power actions and upgrade-mode changes
data.allow_proxmox_control: Allow Proxmox host power actions and upgrades without cleanup (affects guests)
data.enable_repairs: Show repair issues for reboots, failed actions and package updates
data.update_repair_threshold: Package updates per host before creating a repair (0 = off)

package_updates.title: {count} package updates available: {host}
package_updates.description: **{host}** reports **{count} available package updates** (configured threshold: {threshold}). Review the package list and last package-report timestamp in the host's HA device or open RemotePower. Updates may restart services. Nothing is installed automatically. This issue clears when a fresh online report falls below the threshold. Set the package-update repair threshold to 0 in the integration options to disable these messages.

reboot_required.title: Reboot required: {host}
reboot_required.description: RemotePower reports a system or kernel reboot requirement for **{host}**. A Proxmox host reboot interrupts its guests. Choose Repair to explicitly confirm a reboot. Control permissions and RemotePower approvals remain enforced. This issue clears only after a fresh report clears the requirement.

confirm.title: Perform reboot
confirm.description: Reboot **{host}**? Services will be interrupted. On a Proxmox host this affects all guests. Global controls and Proxmox controls must be enabled in the integration options. RemotePower may require a separate approval.

error.reboot_blocked: Reboot blocked or not confirmed. Check host status, permissions, pending actions, maintenance and integration options.

abort.approval_required: Reboot awaits approval in RemotePower. The repair remains open.
abort.reboot_queued: Reboot queued, not yet confirmed. The repair remains open until a fresh host report clears the requirement.

action_failed.title: RemotePower action failed: {host}
action_failed.description: The last tracked action for **{host}** failed. Check the action-status sensor and RemotePower command history before retrying. No automatic upgrade or reboot retry will be performed.

bulk_action.name: Run bulk action
bulk_action.description: Choose exactly one target filter. Actions are queued, not guaranteed completed. Control actions also require confirm and enabled integration options. See the per-host response.
